rv.q: This is one of the few recent plays that you will be sorry when it is over.
Jane Goodall is a disappointingly ho-hum affair.
The new play Have You Met Jane Goodall and Her Mother? is a breezy telling of her origin story and path to success... Her facts, and their fiction, make for a winning mash-up.

cn.t: Critics split on this biographical comedy about Jane Goodall's early career—some find it witty and charming, while others deem it mediocre despite its fascinating subject matter.
